scope.baselines: Historical fixed10m/1s and fixed20m/.4s,1s are unchanged-policy references. The corrected fixed20m/1s OFF identity control checks exact public/private logical equality; other fixed cases are not rerun.
scope.conditional_metrics: Semantic loss, cell side, interval length and observation-to-release delay condition on retained observations.
scope.filtering: ON is a separate root maximum selective-suppression fraction of 0.1; OFF policies retain byte identity. Compare ON/OFF within the same method and contract.
scope.objective: J=(N_input-N_retained+sum_retained taxonomy_loss)/N_input; unit omission cost. Lower is better; experimental utility, not privacy risk.
scope.privacy: Zero audited violations refers to selected operational constraints; neither attack resistance nor a privacy gain is measured.
scope.provenance: Reported source/native result digests are execution receipts from the verified runner; this lightweight report does not reread movement or private arrays.
scope.regional_cohorts: Compare the four named nonexclusive source-point cohorts; regional privacy/utility checks use full-cell intersections. Historical outside-policy-region counts remain as optional provenance, but the corrected audit does not provide this cohort. It is not reconstructed by subtracting overlapping named cohorts. Regional counts must not be summed as a partition.
scope.study: Two frozen sources, one realization each; post hoc implementation repair, no statistical population inference. Different source motion prevents an isolated taxonomy-causality claim.
scope.timing: Historical and corrected core/process timings are separate recordings, not paired statistical estimates. Core excludes simulation, Python audit, rendering and report writing.
